deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: service=runtime slice=seq-slice-2026-04 v=2.3.0 -> regions=[us,eu,apac]; change window 2026-04-01T03:00Z-05:00Z. Canary plan: US 2% (30m) -> EU 10% (20m) -> APAC 5% (hold). Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 200ms OR err_rate > 1% over 5m.

marta: Quick capacity check please — need headroom numbers and any cluster limits per region.

sandeep: Ran the preflight capacity script. Summary:
- US: spare GPUs=8 (pool spare 25%), current util avg=72%, expected cushion for burst=6 nodes
- EU: spare GPUs=5 (pool spare 18%), current util avg=78%, suggest throttling to 8% if spike
- APAC: spare GPUs=2 (pool spare 7%), current util avg=85% -> PROPOSE HOLD APAC until warmup

sandeep: Command I ran:
```
./scripts/capacity_check.sh --regions us,eu,apac --time-window 60
```

jenna: Thanks. Can we pin fallback model v2.2.7 on all routes before the canaries? If canary fails we want immediate switch.

alex: Doing pin now via `redwoodctl pin --service runtime --version v2.2.7 --routes all` (will post output)

alex: Output:
```
[ok] pinned v2.2.7 -> routes: chat,completion,embed
```

deploy-bot: Canary started in US slice (2%). canary_ts=2083337785

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (US @ +15m): p95=42ms p99=118ms err_rate=0.12% throughput=1.8k rps

marta: US looks good. Ops, can we open EU slice now to 10%?

ops-oncall: EU 10% start approved. I'll watch infra dashboard for eviction events. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/seq-slice-deploy

sandeep: EU metrics @ +10m: p99=130ms err_rate=0.4% no OOMs. Approve continue to APAC warmup.

jenna: APAC still low spare capacity. Request extending warmup + adding cache prefill for 45m. I'll coordinate with infra to add burst nodes.

ops-oncall: Adding 4 burst nodes to APAC pool now. ETA 18m.

alex: Noting release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/seq-slice-2.3.0 — pinned fallback listed, rollout schedule, rollback criteria.

marta: +1. Final check: any objections to progressive proceed? If none, we'll start APAC warmup after burst nodes are up.

jenna: no objections :thumbsup:

sandeep: no objections

ops-oncall: no objections, monitoring enabled

deploy-bot: APAC warmup initiated. will hold final traffic migration until manual OK.

alex: I'll wait for burst nodes + cache prefill then signal go. Thanks all.
